scripts.postinstall: npm run build && npm run finstall
scripts.devd: npx hardhat node & npm run deploylh
scripts.build: npx hardhat clean && npx hardhat compile
scripts.coverage: npm run build && npx hardhat coverage --temp artifacts --network coverage
scripts.deploylh: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Pethreon.ts --network localhost
scripts.deploysp: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Pethreon.ts --network sepolia
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run flint && npm run ftypecheck && npm run ftest && npm run fbuild
